decision: PCA major-axis length selected because it produced slightly lower validation EF MAE, RMSE and bias, and lower patient-level absolute EF error in 31 of 50 validation patients.
interpretation_limitation: The difference between PCA and Maximum Feret was small. Selection applies only to the two tested long-axis definitions under this single-plane A4C area-length measurement protocol.
important_observation: Even with ground-truth masks, PCA-derived single-plane EF showed positive disagreement relative to CAMUS reference EF. Therefore downstream EF disagreement cannot be attributed solely to segmentation error.
